notes.title: New Hint System!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42553984/a62939a8e3f9a5a063f06700132674c88e46b845.png[/img]As a result of player feedback, we have developed an optional hint system to show the future result of decisions. Simply hover over a decision pane to show the hint!

P.S. Founder Life is now on also on iOS and Android!
